title: Prognostic subgroups of chronic pain patients using latent variable mixture modeling within a supervised machine learning framework
summary: Latent-variable mixture modeling within nested five-fold cross-validation selected four chronic-pain subgroups; outer test predictions explained about 26% of pain-interference variation in a Swedish specialist registry. This is a retrospective prognostic phenotyping result, not treatment-effect evidence.
